name: list_objects
description: Lists the objects in a bucket.

bucketName.description: Required. The name of the bucket to list objects in. Format: {bucket_id}

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of objects to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 1000 objects will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListObjects` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListObjects` must match the call that provided the page token (except `page_size`, which may differ).

prefix.description: Optional. The prefix to filter objects by. If not specified, all objects are matched. If `recursive` is `false`, only objects at the same level as the prefix are matched. For instance, if `recursive` is `false`, `"documents"` will match `"documents.txt"` but not `"documents/my-file.txt"`.

recursive.description: Optional. Indicates whether the list operation should be recursive, including objects in subdirectories. If false (default), only objects directly within the specified prefix are listed.
